title: Closed-session testimony on Rocky Flats

tellings.quote: I've been back several times in u restricted sessions. >> Okay. >> On security issues with the energy department on especially on Rocky Flats, Colorado.

plain: Former Secretary of Energy John S. Herrington says he has gone back to Congress several times to testify in closed sessions on security at the Energy Department, especially about Rocky Flats, Colorado, a Department of Energy site there. He tells Michels this from his own experience, and he tells it as a sign that what happened at Rocky Flats is still discussed only behind closed doors.
